description: This file contains utility functions for constructing absolute URLs that respect proxy prefixes, primarily used in a server environment to generate correct URLs based on incoming request data.

methods.name: getProxyPrefix
methods.description: Extracts a proxy prefix from the request URL if present, e.g., /proxy/3001.

methods.name: getOrigin
methods.description: Builds the origin URL (protocol + host) from the request, respecting proxy headers.

methods.name: buildAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Constructs an absolute URL for a given path, inserting proxy prefix if detected.
